subject: Fwd: Aurora Health - Azure marketplace unlisted-bundle pricing request
messages:
From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@aurorahealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-21T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Azure marketplace listing - request to include enterprise-bundle SKU

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Aurora is ready to move forward but we have one administrative ask before procurement signs: we run a bundled SKU for hospitals that we price off-catalog at ~25% below list to match existing legacy contracts. For Azure marketplace listing we need either the public listing to reflect that bundle price or a private offer with an equivalent discount.

High-level:
- ARR for year 1: ~$180,000
- We need HIPAA / BAA in place (we have a checklist ready)
- Target: private offer for procurement to sign this week if possible

Can Redwood approve a marketplace private-offer discount of 25% on the enterprise-bundle SKU? If not possible, what is the quickest path (partial discount + co-sell credit, revenue commit, etc.)?

Appreciate a slice of advice on time-to-list and any partner approvals needed.

Best,
Alex
Director of Procurement
Aurora Health Systems

--
Attachment: aurora_requirements_checklist.pdf (attachment stub)

From: irene.choi@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-21T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Aurora Health - Azure marketplace unlisted-bundle pricing request

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Aurora's request. Quick summary and ask:

- Customer wants 25% off marketplace list for an unlisted enterprise bundle SKU.
- ARR ~ $180k, HIPAA/BAA required, wants to close this week.

Options I see:
1) Private offer via Azure marketplace at a 20% discount (standard max we typically approve without exec sign-off) + 5% co-sell support credit; requires finance/deal-desk note.
2) Approve 25% for private offer only if we get a 12-month revenue commit + no additional concessions; requires marketplace waiver and product approval for unlisted SKU on the portal.

I've attached a quick pricing model snapshot (pricing_model_v2.xlsx). Can you two weigh in on margin impact and whether we can make an exception to 25%? If we need escalation, who should sign off (finance VP or CRO)?

Timelines: Aurora wants docs this week. If we can get private-offer terms in 48 hours, procurement will sign and we can expedite DocuSign.

Thanks,
Irene
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0813

--
Attachment: pricing_model_v2.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-21T15:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Aurora Health - Azure marketplace unlisted-bundle pricing request

Irene — thanks for the context and the model. Quick read and recommendation below (numbers are rough but directionally accurate):

- Baseline list price for bundle: $240k ARR equivalent.
- 20% private-offer discount => $192k (loss to list: $48k). With marketplace fees (~10%) and infra, net impact acceptable given the account size and potential for expansion.
- 25% discount => $180k — pushes margin under our typical threshold for public/private offers without extra commitments.

Recommendation: Approve a 20% private-offer discount today, contingent on:
  * 12-month minimum revenue commit (PO/contract)
  * No other discounts or professional-services credits beyond what’s in the PO
  * Co-sell support credit of 5% to Azure partner team (we'll pass through)

If Aurora truly needs 25%, we can consider a one-time uplift to 25% if:
  * CRO or VP Finance signs off, and
  * Customer signs a 12-month + 10% expansion commit in writing.

I attached a quick calc showing margin sensitivity (pricing_impact_calc.csv). If we move forward at 20% I can approve from deal-desk side; 25% requires escalation to Marissa and finance leadership.

Rishi
Head of Deal Desk, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: pricing_impact_calc.csv (attachment stub)

From: irene.choi@redwood.com
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-22T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Azure marketplace listing - request to include enterprise-bundle SKU

Hi Alex — good news: we can move forward with a private offer in Azure marketplace with the following approved terms:

1) Private-offer discount: 20% off list for the enterprise-bundle SKU.
2) Minimum term: 12 months, one-time PO for year 1 (covers $192,000).
3) Co-sell support: Redwood will provide joint sales materials and targeted co-sell outreach; Azure co-sell credit of 5% applied per Rishi.
4) Security: we will sign BAA and provide SOC2 evidence as part of the procurement packet.

If Aurora is able to commit to a 10% expansion guarantee in writing (paper trail), I can request a one-time exception to 25% from Marissa and finance. Let me know if that is possible.

Next steps:
- Please review and sign the PO via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Signing/?s=abc123-aurora-po
- HubSpot record updated: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/RDW-AUR-2027-021
- Once PO is signed, Laura will coordinate the Azure private-offer creation and listing. Expect listing + co-sell enablement in ~3 business days after PO is complete.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we can hop on a 15-min call if you want to walk through the terms.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
